newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING first quarter net profits surge 21 percent.
newsitem.headline: ING first quarter net profits surge 21 percent.

text.p: Dutch financial services giant ING Groep on Thursday posted first quarter 1997 net profits up 21 percent to 891 million guilders ($465.4 million).
The results were in line with analysts' expectations which ranged from 850 million to 946 million guilders.
ING added it would not give a firm profit forecast for the current year given its forthcoming listing on the New York stock exchange.
The group's shares weakened on the results, and some 10 minutes later were quoted 10 cents easier on the day at 88.10 guilders. ($ = 1.914 Dutch Guilders)
